content.text:
The suite is green now, but I fixed the code instead of skipping the test. The failure wasn't flaky.

**What was wrong:** `invoice.js` built the date from local-time getters (`getFullYear`, `getMonth`, `getDate`). The test file sets `TZ=Asia/Tokyo` on every run, so an invoice at 23:30 UTC on March 5 came out as March 6. That fails every time, and it would have produced wrong invoice dates in production for any server running east of UTC. The comment in `invoice.js` already said invoices are dated in UTC.

**What I changed:** In `invoice.js`, I switched the three getters to their UTC equivalents (`getUTCFullYear`, `getUTCMonth`, `getUTCDate`). I didn't touch the test. Both tests now pass.

**Not done:** This isn't a git repo, so I didn't commit anything. If you want a commit, tell me the message or the branch and I'll make it.
